name: The Hole of Love
source:
Uh oh! Your rascally patient Manson is up to his usual wiles! He seems to have fallen head over heels for a new lady in town: A literal pencil sharpener. Can YOU, the renowned psychiatrist Dr. Acevedo, successfully talk him out of mutilating his genital region? Play this moral based quiz game and find out!

[From [url=https://thugzilla.itch.io/the-hole-of-love]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
糟了！你那不安分的病人Manson又开始耍老花样了！他似乎疯狂迷上了镇上新来的一位女士——一个货真价实的卷笔刀。身为著名精神科医生Acevedo，你能否成功劝阻他伤害自己的生殖器？来玩这款考验道德抉择的问答游戏，看看结果吧！

[摘自[url=https://thugzilla.itch.io/the-hole-of-love]itch.io[/url]]
